paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved -0.25% on average, with Nikkei 225 strongest (+0.53%) and Hang Seng weakest (-1.55%). Brent crude changed +0.34% to 96.15. Gold changed +0.35% to 3,899.0. Bitcoin changed -2.98% to 69,213.3906. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.103%, a relative move of +2.10%. Among the firms tracked, Newmont (-4.92%) and Carlyle (-4.28%) moved the most.
